messages:
Marissa Chen (Sales): Hey team - closed _Scarlett Health_ (Enterprise, HIPAA) today. Passing to CS for onboarding + to eng/support for SSO and private VPC setup. TL;DR: 10 seats, will start POC next Tue, likely dedicated capacity in month 2. Renewal flagged as high priority (12mo, expansion possible). Deal link: https://sales.redwood/opp/SC-0912 :party:
Owen Brooks (CS): Thanks Marissa - copying checklist: 1) SSO SAML config 2) Private VPC networking 3) Dedicated pool sizing 4) Onboarding playbook + enablement session. Assigning owners below.
Priya Singh (Support): @Owen I can take the infra/support ticket for VPC & SSO validation. Need vendor contact + certs. Can you drop the customer contact and RFC?
Marissa Chen (Sales): @Priya contact is kate.lin@scarletthealth.com, infra lead is Raj Kapoor. They prefer TLS mutual auth; mentioned HSM for keys. I've uploaded signed NDA + SOC docs to the deal.
Diego Ramos (Solutions Eng): I'll own the dedicated pool sizing + run a quick perf projection. Need expected QPS and prompt length distribution. Kate said "mostly short queries, avg 60 tokens, peak 80 RPS". Is that accurate?
Owen Brooks (CS): That matches my notes. Action owners: Onboarding plan + exec touch = Owen; VPC/SSO support ticket = Priya; Dedicated sizing = Diego; Enablement deck + 1st-run playbook = Owen. I'll schedule a kickoff for Mon 09:00 PT.
Priya Singh (Support): Creating ticket now: INC-8152. Attaching checklist: - VPN peering steps - Subnet/CIDR ask - TLS mTLS cert exchange - KMS/HSM key integration - Audit log forwarding. ETA for initial validation: 48h after receiving certs.
EnablementBot: Reminder: enablement template used for HIPAA customers requires encryption checklist and signed BAAs. Template: /templates/enablement/hipaa-onboard-v2.pdf
Marissa Chen (Sales): One more wrinkle: procurement wants a 30-day SLA in contract with uptime and response windows. Finance asked for pricing floor confirmation for dedicated GPUs. Adding @Diego and @Owen so customers don't hit delays.
Diego Ramos (Solutions Eng): I'll confirm the committed throughput + pricing note by EOD. Also will prep a lightweight load test plan (k6 script) to validate dedicated pool assumptions.
Owen Brooks (CS): Prep items for kickoff: - Pre-req doc send to Kate - Schedule 60m enablement (eng plus CS) - Create success criteria (uptime, latency P95, onboarding tasks) - Renewal/expansion play (owner: Marissa). I'll DM Kate with pre-reqs after this thread.
Priya Singh (Support): Quick ask for engineering: can we get a sample VPC peering policy and port list? putting this in INC-8152 comments.
Diego Ramos (Solutions Eng): Sample snippet (for infra):
```
# allow outbound to redwood egress
cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
ports: [443, 22]
# KV cache/metrics
ports: [9000-9010]
```
I'll attach a full.yaml to the ticket.
Owen Brooks (CS): Renewal risk note: procurement pushing discount; Marissa will own negotiation. We should set a 90-day success review and tie expansion playbook to adoption metrics.
Marissa Chen (Sales): Got it. I'll own renewal cadence and add a clause for expansion review at month 3.
Priya Singh (Support): Added initial validation checklist to INC-8152 and pinged infra on their side. Will update ticket with timeline after Raj confirms certs.
Owen Brooks (CS): Thanks all. Next steps recap (owners): Marissa - contract/review; Owen - kickoff + enablement; Diego - sizing + load test; Priya - INC-8152 + SSO/VPC validation. I'll post meeting invite and attach pre-req doc. :thumbsup:
Marissa Chen (Sales): Thanks team - excited to get Scarlett live.
